==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
I induced lucidity via sleep paralysis. I returned to the skatepark to face off against the Pink Were-Beagle. (This dream takes place in the same continuity of lucid dreams that started on 06/11/2025 and has continued to the present. These dreams take place in the Elven Village that resembles huts of wood and white stone, as well as castles, and is located in a forest of tall pine trees.) (The Elven Village Skatepark resembles a skatepark made up of ramps and rails made of wood and white stone.) (The Pink Were-Beagle resembles a large, muscular, pink, humanoid beagle wearing a blue jumpsuit and black boots.)
I used the Aegis spell to defend myself. The Were-Beagle was a mindless brute who couldn't be reasoned with. (Aegis is the Greek word for divine protection. It represents an indestructible defense.)
I used the Keraunos spell to defeat them with a single attack. (Keraunos is the Greek word for divine lightning, the weapon Zeus used to control the cosmos.)
